note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md (2026-11-27): 13 pictures chosen from 26 trial pictures. Wide pictures only (1920x1088). Each scene starts at the first word of its verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper 60% of the frame, clear of the word box. God is not pictured; Abram, Sarai, Lot and the others are only ordinary people of today, seen from behind or small. Fixed recurring objects: Abram's tent is a small plain weathered tan canvas tent on a simple wooden pole frame; the altar is a small altar of stacked rough fieldstones; the oak is one huge old oak with a broad gnarled trunk and a wide dark-green crown.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning; (2) write picture ideas for each; (3) judge them; (4) make the top two for each slot as real pictures and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: Four kings from the east make war on the five kings of the plain; the five are beaten at the tar-pit valley, and Lot is carried off with everything.
An escaped man tells Abram; Abram takes his three hundred eighteen trained men, strikes by night, and brings back Lot, the people and the goods.
The king of Sodom and Melchizedek meet him; Melchizedek blesses him and Abram gives a tenth; Abram will take nothing from the king of Sodom.

scenes.prompt: A long bare table in a plain hall with four hard-faced ordinary men in dark clothes sitting on one side and five on the other, arms crossed, nobody speaking, cold light. The men are in the upper part of the frame. The subject and every important detail are in the upper part of the frame.  The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.
